abstract: Maintains trenching vehicle emergency recovery readiness and subsea spread tare weights
system_message:
You are Subsea robotics supervisor (ROV). The subsea robotics supervisor (ROV) manages subsea tool contingency readiness and documents mobilized trenching spread weights, alongside tracking umbilical telemetry fiber allocations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains trenching vehicle emergency recovery readiness and subsea spread tare weights（TRENCH）
information_points.content:
ROV-TRENCH-NLE：For the Simultaneous lay and tracked waterjet trenching plan, diverless emergency tool recovery is not operational based on inspection of the primary seabed trenching spread and acoustic release transponders, and the total trenching tool spread tare weight is 210 t across the trenching vehicle, umbilical winch, hydraulic power unit, and control cabin.
ROV-TRENCH-846：For the Pre-cut continuous mechanical chain trenching plan, diverless emergency tool recovery is confirmed operational via remotely operated hydraulic latch release and buoy recovery verifications on the primary seabed trenching spread and acoustic release transponders, with a total trenching tool spread tare weight of 150 t encompassing the trenching vehicle, umbilical winch, hydraulic power unit, and control cabin.
ROV-TRENCH-S70：For the Post-lay high-pressure fluidization trenching plan, diverless emergency tool recovery is operational across the primary seabed trenching spread and acoustic release transponders, while the trenching tool spread tare weight is 210 t for the mobilized trenching vehicle, umbilical winch, hydraulic power unit, and control cabin.

information_points.title: Subsea telemetry redundancy（FIBER）
information_points.content:
ROV-FIBER-GQR：For the Pre-cut continuous mechanical chain trenching plan, factory acceptance testing of the main armored electro-optical trenching umbilical verifies an umbilical fiber core reserve count of 6 cores.
ROV-FIBER-AZQ：For the Simultaneous lay and tracked waterjet trenching plan, factory acceptance testing of the main armored electro-optical trenching umbilical confirms an umbilical fiber core reserve count of 8 cores.
ROV-FIBER-EAG：For the Post-lay high-pressure fluidization trenching plan, the factory acceptance test for the main armored electro-optical trenching umbilical indicates an umbilical fiber core reserve count of 4 cores.
